events.name: oracle_entry_viewed
events.definition: The Oracle conversation surface became visible.
events.trigger: Once when the Oracle surface mounts.

events.name: oracle_category_selected
events.definition: An optional server-owned qualification category was selected.
events.trigger: On category selection, before any model request.

events.name: oracle_first_question_submitted
events.definition: The first user-authored question was submitted.
events.trigger: Immediately before the first oracle-chat request.

events.name: oracle_first_response
events.definition: The first successful response started rendering.
events.trigger: On the first delivered assistant content.

events.name: oracle_message_sent
events.definition: Legacy message event retained for historical continuity.
events.trigger: Existing surface-specific trigger.

events.name: oracle_second_turn
events.definition: A second user turn reached its historical trigger.
events.trigger: Second turn according to the existing surface.

events.name: oracle_limit_hit
events.definition: The server refused a question because the quota was exhausted.
events.trigger: On oracle-chat HTTP 402.

events.name: paywall_viewed
events.definition: A quota decision surface was rendered.
events.trigger: After rendering the quota surface.

events.name: oracle_handoff_click
events.definition: A user chose the account or pricing handoff.
events.trigger: On explicit handoff click.

events.name: paywall_etoile_click
events.definition: The Star offer CTA was clicked.
events.trigger: On the Star CTA click.

events.name: paywall_offer_view
events.definition: The one-time reading alternative was expanded.
events.trigger: On first expansion.

events.name: paywall_offer_date_entered
events.definition: A valid-looking date was entered for the paid one-time reading.
events.trigger: On non-empty date change.

events.name: paywall_offer_checkout_click
events.definition: The one-time reading checkout was requested.
events.trigger: Before the checkout request.

events.name: oracle_feedback_submitted
events.definition: Feedback was submitted after an Oracle response.
events.trigger: After feedback persistence succeeds.

events.name: oracle_profile_started
events.definition: Legacy profile-start signal.
events.trigger: On profile form interaction.

events.name: oracle_profile_submitted
events.definition: Legacy profile completion signal.
events.trigger: After profile submission.

events.name: oracle_signup_wall_viewed
events.definition: The free-profile continuation wall became visible.
events.trigger: After an anonymous pending turn is stored.

events.name: oracle_signup_wall_cta_clicked
events.definition: The free-profile continuation action was clicked.
events.trigger: On explicit free-profile continuation click.

events.name: oracle_pending_turn_created
events.definition: A voluntary question was encrypted as a pending turn.
events.trigger: After the server confirms pending-turn persistence.

events.name: oracle_activation_continuation_delivered
events.definition: The one-time personalized post-onboarding continuation was delivered.
events.trigger: After successful streamed delivery and grant consumption.

events.name: oracle_post_continuation_message
events.definition: A voluntary message followed a personalized continuation within 30 minutes.
events.trigger: Before the first voluntary post-continuation request.

events.name: oracle_acquisition_cta_viewed_v1
events.definition: A marked post-result acquisition surface reached the viewport.
events.trigger: Once when 40 percent of the explicit result CTA is visible.

events.name: oracle_acquisition_cta_clicked_v1
events.definition: The Oracle link on a marked post-result acquisition surface was clicked.
events.trigger: Before storing the same-origin Oracle handoff.

events.name: oracle_entry_viewed_v2
events.definition: The public Oracle loaded from a valid Lot C acquisition handoff.
events.trigger: Once after consuming a marked same-origin acquisition handoff.

events.name: oracle_first_question_submitted_v1
events.definition: The first user-authored question followed a valid Lot C acquisition handoff.
events.trigger: Immediately before the first Oracle request in an acquisition session.

events.name: oracle_first_response_delivered_v1
events.definition: The first Oracle response began rendering after a valid Lot C acquisition handoff.
events.trigger: On the first delivered assistant content in an acquisition session.

events.name: oracle_feedback_viewed
events.definition: The minimal feedback choices became visible after the first successful Oracle response.
events.trigger: Once after the first successful response is complete.

events.name: oracle_feedback
events.definition: A content-free satisfaction choice was submitted for the first successful Oracle response.
events.trigger: On the first click of one of the three feedback choices.

events.name: oracle_feedback_submit_failed
events.definition: A content-free Oracle feedback persistence attempt failed before user confirmation.
events.trigger: After a rejected, unavailable or unconfigured durable feedback insert.

events.name: pricing_viewed
events.definition: The App pricing surface became visible after authentication state resolved.
events.trigger: Once when Pricing mounts and auth loading completes.

events.name: etoile_pass_offer_viewed
events.definition: A preassigned 48-hour Star Pass offer became visible in the app.
events.trigger: Once when an offered Pass card mounts.

events.name: etoile_pass_activation_requested
events.definition: The user explicitly requested activation of the preassigned Pass.
events.trigger: Immediately before the activation request.

events.name: etoile_pass_activation_succeeded
events.definition: The server confirmed effective Pass access.
events.trigger: After a successful activation response.

events.name: etoile_pass_activation_failed
events.definition: A requested Pass activation did not produce effective access.
events.trigger: After a rejected or unavailable activation response.
